Cross the glass bridge to the far platform before time runs out.
The bridge has 18 rows of two glass panels. In every row one panel is tempered and holds you; the other shatters and you fall.
Nobody knows which is which. You cross one at a time, in an order drawn at random; the gate calls you when it is your turn.
What you see is all you know: when a panel shatters or holds, everyone behind learns which one was safe. A fragile panel cracks the instant you touch it.
Take longer than %s s to reach the next row and the glass gives way beneath you.
Time limit %s. Whoever has not crossed when it runs out is eliminated. Difficulty: %s.
